reviews.text: I've been a customer at another Joker branch, and my dog ​​is also a Joker alumnus, so I wanted to stop by and support them if I was in the area. However, the Roppongi branch was unfriendly, and I won't be going back. It's especially disappointing considering the high quality of the dogs in that area. I've been to many branches, but this was the worst.
A pet shop located in Roppongi Hills. They have a wide selection of pet food and other supplies.

The grooming used to be skillful and meticulous, but this time the result was disappointing.

It was so uneven that you wouldn't think it had been groomed, and the cut wasn't cute at all, which made me sad.

I don't know if the quality has declined because they renovated and increased staff, or if it's because the management company changed a few years ago, but the cut wasn't good enough to make me want to go to Joker's even if it was more expensive than other places.

I don't know if it's because many people feel the same way, but it's overwhelmingly easier to get an appointment here compared to other places.

I've only ever gone shopping, so I don't know much about it, but U.X.U is unfriendly.

This was my first time ordering a dog cake here, and it will definitely be my last. It may be a major chain, but there's a hotel and grooming center nearby, and it's in Roppongi Hills, so I thought it would be okay, but the employee, Yamashita, was working on his computer the whole time while I was standing at the register. I wondered if he was just working part-time, or if he just didn't want to be there anymore. However, if a customer is standing at the register for a long time, I think it's common sense to give priority to them. I'm disappointed. The cake's appearance was also below average. You should definitely go somewhere else.

I don't usually post reviews, but this time it was so bad that I decided to.
